description: Authored Phase 7 development regression fixed before prompt experiments. General-policy paraphrases versus missing personal status, named-entity scope and unsupported attributes. Not held out.

pages.text: Harbor Tools delivers standard orders within 12 working days after payment clears. Express orders require written approval from the dispatch manager.
Harbor Tools accepts returns only with an original receipt. The company does not accept returns of personalized equipment.
Meadow Library lends reference books for 21 calendar days. A borrower may renew a loan only if no other reader has reserved the book.
Cobalt Stores delivers standard orders within 4 business days after the warehouse confirms stock. This document does not describe any individual customer's shipment.
